options.name: Sports Massage
options.detail: Focused pressure, compression, friction, and movement to work overloaded soft tissue.

options.name: Infrared Therapy
options.detail: Red and near-infrared light to support pain relief and recovery before bodywork.

options.name: Fascial Stretch Therapy
options.detail: Supported positions, guided movement, and hands-on techniques to improve mobility without sharp pain.

options.name: Hot Towel Massage
options.detail: Warm, moist towels before focused bodywork to ease stiffness and tense tissue.

options.name: Myofascial Release Therapy
options.detail: Slow, focused pressure to address restricted tissue and tender areas.

options.name: Acupressure Massage
options.detail: Steady pressure on specific points blended with pressure point therapy to ease muscle guarding and restricted movement.

options.name: Cupping Therapy
options.detail: Suction to gently lift skin and soft tissue to reduce pain and improve flexibility.

options.name: Hot Stone Massage
options.detail: Warmed basalt stones during massage to make tight areas feel more comfortable and support flexibility.

options.name: Deep Tissue Massage
options.detail: Slow, focused techniques with controlled pressure to work into deeper muscle and connective tissue layers.

blurb: 410 Muscle Therapy in Timonium offers focused hands-on assessment and precise deep tissue work to address stubborn knots, restricted fascia, and movement limits. Sessions are tailored to individual body, activity level, and symptoms. Services support desk workers, athletes, and people managing tightness, chronic muscle tension, or mobility concerns.
